_meta.rule: Every value carries src (key into sources), loc, and a short quote from the saved document. derived = arithmetic done here from sourced values (is_derived = the value itself is derived). alternatives = other sourced values (conflicts). note = context or caveat. Every quote was machine-checked against the saved file's extracted text (whitespace/glyph-normalised).
_meta.quote_normalisation: Quotes copied from pdftotext (layout and raw) / HTML text (PostScript sources rendered to PDF with Ghostscript first); NFKC (ligatures), primes, quotes, degree glyphs, micro signs, dashes, table bars and soft hyphens normalised; ' ... ' joins non-adjacent pieces; table rows quoted as whitespace-separated cells; a piece also passes if it matches with all whitespace removed or with line-end hyphenation ('- ') removed. Quotes keep the text layer's glyph losses (e.g. '54:49 line=mm', 'bers', '63 240'); each source cite lists them.

fire.title: Magellan I (Baade) / FIRE (Folded-port InfraRed Echellette, echellette mode: R1 echelle in quasi-Littrow, four-prism ZnSe + Infrasil 301 cross-disperser with six passes, optics at ~100 K)
fire.recommended_preset: Echellette mode, 0.6" x 6" slit (the nominal slit, R = 6000). D = 6.5 m, F = 11 (Magellan f/11 folded port; 2.10 mm per 6" = 0.350 mm/arcsec at the slit, DERIVED), 1 object, mirror collimator (off-axis paraboloid, parent focal length 555 mm, from R = 1110.16 mm) -> W = 50 mm as stated (555/11 = 50.45 DERIVED), camera: refractive (CaF2 / S-FTM-16 / CaF2 + Infrasil 301 flattener), f = 176.8 mm (F/3.5 in the 50 mm direction); echelle 54.49 gr/mm R1, delta = 46 deg, quasi-Littrow (theta and gamma NOT published: 0 here), orders 11-32; cross-disperser = six prism passes in path order: Infrasil 301 P1 A = 42.6 deg (single pass), Infrasil 301 P2 A = 28.1 deg, ZnSe P3 A = 21.81 deg, [echelle], ZnSe P3 again, Infrasil P2 again, ZnSe P4 A = 21.81 deg (single pass) (Infrasil apex angles DERIVED from the printed tan(A/2) = 0.39 and 0.25, +/-0.5 deg); glasses at the 100 K design temperature (CHARMS; new entries Infrasil301-100K / ZnSe-100K below, or the app's 105 K entries, which differ by <= 3e-4 in n); central wavelength NOT published -- 1.20 um (order ~22) puts the order stack symmetric about the detector centre in the app's minimum-deviation model (DERIVED); detector Teledyne HAWAII-2RG 2048 x 2048 x 18 um (pitch from the Teledyne brochure; no FIRE document states it). CAVEAT: FIRE's prisms are deliberately NOT at minimum deviation (they compress the 50 mm beam to 50 x 30 mm), so an app trace with all prisms at minimum deviation spreads orders 11-32 over only ~1320 px (DERIVED) instead of most of the 2048-px height; expect the app to under-predict the cross-dispersion and order separation by ~1.4-1.8x and to give a ~0.163"/px spatial scale instead of the published 0.09-0.12"/px. Validate against: R = 6000 at 0.6" and 8000 at 0.45" (published; geometric DERIVED 5520 / 7370), 12.5 km/s per pixel (published; Littrow DERIVED 14.74 km/s/px with 18 um pixels), 0.15"/px along the dispersion (published; DERIVED 0.163), coverage 0.82-2.51 um in orders 11-32, reddest order (11, FSR 2.29-2.51 um) matched to the detector width (Littrow FSR length 1849 px DERIVED).

Collimator: off-axis paraboloid (S13, S10) vs "tilted field lens and on-axis spherical mirror" (FDS; copied on LCOFE) -- pre-construction design.
Double-pass prisms: two (S13, S10) vs one (FDS; copied on LCOFE).
Prism glass: Infrasil 301 (S13, S10) vs "Fused Silica" (LCOFE component list) -- Infrasil is an IR-grade fused quartz, so this is a naming difference.
Operating temperature: 100 K design indices (S13), bench 90-100 K (S13, S10), 100 K (LCOFE) vs 77 K (FDS; S13 back-up configuration).
Slit widths: 0.45-1.0" (LCOFM, LCOH, FWS) vs 0.3-2.0" (FSS, pre-construction).
Resolution at 0.45": R = 8000 (LCOH, FWO) vs DERIVED geometric 7370.
notes: Cross-dispersion caveat (DERIVED): with all six prism passes at minimum deviation (the app model) orders 32-11 span only 23.7 mm = 1319 px, the order spacing is 53-87 px, and the spatial scale stays at the unmagnified 0.163"/px. The real prisms compress the beam to 50 x 30 mm (angular magnification ~1.67), which gives the published 0.09-0.12"/px along the slit and should spread the orders over most of the 2048-px height with "several arcseconds" of dark pixels between 6" slits. Expect the app to under-predict FIRE's cross-dispersion by ~1.4-1.8x; the echelle direction (R, km/s/px, FSR fill) is unaffected.

Path order through the prisms (S13 Table 2): P1 (Infrasil, single) -> P2 (Infrasil) -> P3 (ZnSe) -> echelle -> P3 -> P2 -> P4 (ZnSe, single) -> camera. S13: "three upstream prism passes (2 Infrasil and one ZnSe)".

Glasses: S13 traced the design with CHARMS indices at 100 K (Leviton et al. 2005, 2008 = LFK05, LFM08). The app's 105 K entries differ from 100 K by -1.8e-5 (Infrasil) and -2.5e-4 to -3.1e-4 (ZnSe) in n, and by 0.1% in the ZnSe dispersion n(0.82)-n(2.40) (DERIVED): either set works; 100 K coefficients are given below.

Consistency (DERIVED): the 54.49 gr/mm, 46 deg echelle with f_cam = 176.8 mm puts the reddest order (11) over 1849 of 2048 px in Littrow, matching S13's "detector dimension is matched the free spectral range of its reddest order"; the blaze peaks 26.403/m um reproduce the 0.82-2.51 um coverage (order 11 FSR to 2.509 um; order 32 from 0.812 um).
FIRE also has a low-dispersion (prism-only) long-slit mode with a flat mirror in place of the grating (R ~ 300-500); only the echellette mode is relevant here.
Moves: FIRE was installed on Baade on 2010 March 28 (S13); moved AUX2 -> AUX1 in September 2022 (LCOFU).

notes: FDR, KP98 and K99 describe FEROS at the ESO 1.52 m (f/15, 2.7" apertures, 50" object-sky separation). In October 2002 the spectrograph moved unchanged to the MPG/ESO 2.2 m; only the telescope feed changed (f/8 beam, rod microlenses to f/4.6, 2.0" apertures 2.9 arcmin apart; FUM78).
